sections.Profile:
"Eight Ball," released by Bally in September 1977, is a classic pinball machine that was one of the most successful games of its era, holding a production run of 20,230 units. Designed by George Christian with artwork by Margaret Hudson and Paul Faris, the game features a pool theme and integrates elements of billiards into its playfield design.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1977–1985
